Break `src/domain/billing.ts → src/presentation/invoice-view.ts`.

Why: it is the only cycle edge explicitly identified, and it also violates the configured architecture rule that domain code cannot import presentation code. Removing it fixes both the high-severity cycle and the medium-severity layer violation.

Move invoice rendering/orchestration into `billing-flow.ts` or `invoice-view.ts`. If shared data is needed, define a plain billing/invoice DTO or interface in the domain (or a dependency-free leaf module), then let presentation import that type—using `import type` when it is type-only. The dependency direction should remain:

`presentation → application/domain`, never `domain → presentation`.
